 Belinda Bencic Falls to an Underdog Once Again
 Belinda Bencic Falls to an Underdog Once Again
 Keystone
 Belinda Bencic remains in a slump. At the WTA 500 tournament in Ningbo, China, the player from eastern Switzerland lost in the second round to qualifier Katarzyna Kawa of Poland.
 Keystone-SDA 
 Today at 11:17 The 5-7, 2-6 loss to an opponent ranked 128th in the world—more than 100 spots behind her—marks yet another failed attempt to break out of her ongoing slump, put the past few weeks of disappointments behind her, and regain her confidence. The loss in her first match against the underdog Kawa is a seamless continuation of a series of defeats against opponents ranked significantly lower than her.
 With her elimination from the tournament in the coastal city in eastern China, Bencic failed to win two consecutive matches for the first time since early August and her run to the quarterfinals at the WTA 1000 tournament in Toronto.
 This latest early exit will also result in another drop in the world rankings. In the next update, coming out this Monday, Bencic will lose the 500 points she earned twelve months ago for winning the tournament in Tokyo. In Ningbo, she earned only 60 points.
